title: Comet in IOMETE 4.0: Same SQL, 42% Less Time
summary: Apache DataFusion Comet in IOMETE 4.0 accelerates Spark SQL natively. TPC-DS results, memory setup, and when to leave the switch off.
body_markdown:
Two kinds. Workloads dominated by operators Comet cannot run natively, such as Scala or Python UDFs, pay for columnar conversion at the boundary without the native speedup. Memory-constrained computes that depend on a large executor JVM heap for caching, or for aggregations and joins that spill once the heap shrinks, can also lose more than they gain; the driver heap is untouched.


On IOMETE the switch is per compute, so a workload that regresses can stay on plain Spark while the rest of the platform runs accelerated.
